newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Grupo Minsa plans cornflour plant.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Grupo Minsa plans cornflour plant.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Minsa S.A. said on Monday it will start building a corn flour manufacturing plant in the central Mexican city of San Luis Potosi in July.

"We will probably break ground in July," said Juan Gargallo, the firm's director general. Corn flour is the basic ingredient for Mexican pancakes called tortillas which are eaten more widely than bread.

Some $20 million in investment will go into the new plant, which will boost the firm's annual processing capacity to 1.8 million tonnes by the end of 1998 compared with 1.4 million in December 1996, Gargallo said.
